answer.reason: The verses tell of Pharaoh refusing Moses, his firstborn dying, and his army drowning in the sea, which add to the summary.

clauses.english: refused Moses' demand to let Israel go and hardened his heart through the plagues
clauses.quote: I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

clauses.english: lost his firstborn when the LORD smote all the firstborn of Egypt, and let Israel go
clauses.quote: at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt

clauses.english: pursued Israel with his army and was overthrown in the sea
clauses.quote: the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh

doubts: EXO 18:4 (the sword of Pharaoh) may refer to an earlier Pharaoh and was left out.
SNG 1:9 and 1SA 2:27 were left out as not about this king's deeds.
